title: CPSC Recall Evidence Matcher
description: Check products against official U.S. CPSC recall records by product name, UPC/GTIN, or model number. Get candidate matches with evidence and source links; verify descriptive matches before acting.

title: Federal Contract Award Intel
description: Search USAspending.gov contract awards by NAICS code, keyword, agency, and date range. Returns up to 100 records with recipients, award values, and reported end dates. For market research; past awards aren’t open bids or proof of a future recompete.

title: NHTSA Vehicle Recall Lookup
description: Search official NHTSA safety recall records by vehicle make, model, and year. Get structured recall details, including campaign numbers, affected components, safety issues, remedies, and source links.
